snippet.title: Renhergade Platinum Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing a new project that has been designed for the first all women's nuzlocking competition! 

Streaming this Friday, 12pm PST/8pm GMT in full over on my Twitch channel https://www.twitch.tv/kyacolosseum

With all the men of the region mysteriously vanishing due to a phenomenon known as "The Manishing", you, a young girl from Twinleaf town will have to venture forth and put together the pieces of what really happened 6 months ago. 

With only 4 gyms, new buffed starters and a whole bunch of QOL features including but not limited to. 

-PC anywhere 
-Level caps 
-Infinite Rare Candies 
-Move relearner in bag 
-Follow Pokemon 

This is sure to be an adventure you remember. 

Download here: https://projectpokemon.org/home/files/file/5831-pokemon-renhergade-platinum/ 

Game development done by Kalaay and Drazerk
Title card by RarestCandy
Music by Dr Pez: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lqcne59fCnc
